movies.title: Big Buck Bunny
movies.plot: A gentle giant rabbit enjoys a quiet day in the forest until three mischievous rodents push him too far. Time for a carefully planned revenge.

movies.title: Sintel
movies.plot: A lonely young woman searches across snowy mountains and crowded cities for the baby dragon she once rescued, and learns that the journey has changed her more than she thinks.

movies.title: Tears of Steel
movies.plot: In a future Amsterdam overrun by robots, a group of scientists tries to rescue the world by replaying a painful breakup from the past.

movies.title: Elephants Dream
movies.plot: Two men wander through a vast, ever-changing machine. One believes it is a world of wonders; the other starts to doubt everything he is shown.

movies.file: Cosmos Laundromat - First Cycle - Official Blender Foundation release
movies.title: Cosmos Laundromat
movies.plot: On a desolate island, a suicidal sheep named Franck meets a mysterious salesman who offers him the gift of a lifetime: as many lives as he wants.

movies.title: Spring
movies.plot: A shepherd girl and her dog face ancient spirits in order to bring the cycle of life back to their frozen valley.

movies.title: Night of the Living Dead
movies.plot: A group of strangers barricade themselves in a remote farmhouse as the recently dead rise and close in from every side.

movies.title: Nosferatu
movies.plot: A young estate agent travels to the Carpathian mountains to sell a house to the mysterious Count Orlok, unaware of the terror he is bringing home.

movies.title: Charade
movies.plot: In Paris, a young widow is pursued by several men looking for the fortune her late husband stole, and doesn't know which of them she can trust.

movies.title: His Girl Friday
movies.plot: A newspaper editor uses every trick in the book to keep his ex-wife, his best reporter, from remarrying and leaving the paper.

movies.title: The General
movies.plot: When Union spies steal his beloved locomotive, a Southern train engineer sets off alone in pursuit, in one of the great chase films of the silent era.

shows.title: Caminandes
shows.plot: Koro, a curious llama from Patagonia, keeps running into obstacles on his way to a better meal, and always finds a creative way around them.

episodes.title: Llama Drama
episodes.plot: Koro wants to cross a road, but a fence stands between him and the green grass on the other side.

episodes.file: Caminandes - Gran Dillama - Blender Foundation's new Open Movie
episodes.title: Gran Dillama
episodes.plot: Koro discovers an electric fence, and a very determined way to get past it.

episodes.title: Llamigos
episodes.plot: In the middle of winter, Koro meets Oti, a pesky penguin with an eye on the same berries.
